request.query: continuity at zero of real power with strictly positive constant exponent multiplied by a constant

items.name: ENNReal.continuous_rpow_const
items.type: ∀ {y : ℝ}, Continuous fun a => a ^ y

items.name: Real.continuousAt_const_rpow
items.type: ∀ {a b : ℝ}, a ≠ 0 → ContinuousAt (fun x => a ^ x) b

items.name: Real.continuousAt_rpow_of_pos
items.type: ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), 0 < p.2 → ContinuousAt (fun p => p.1 ^ p.2) p

items.name: Real.continuousAt_rpow_const
items.type: ∀ (x q : ℝ), x ≠ 0 ∨ 0 ≤ q → ContinuousAt (fun x => x ^ q) x

items.name: continuousAt_const_cpow'
items.type: ∀ {a b : ℂ}, b ≠ 0 → ContinuousAt (fun x => a ^ x) b
